topics.title: The AMREye starting point
text: AMREye is developing a calibrated plate-reading workflow for endpoint disk diffusion. The present website demonstration uses synthetic measurements. Clinical performance has not been established.

topics.title: Prototype, product proposal and future research
text: Keep three stages separate: the endpoint plate-reader prototype, the proposed modular instrument family, and future biological applications. A visual concept or a working website is not a validated laboratory instrument.

topics.title: BAHU: Bio Automation Human User Interface
text: BAHU is the proposed operator-facing layer connecting sample identity, workflow steps, instrument state, review and reporting. A qualified person remains responsible for laboratory decisions.

topics.title: Software as a Service and System as a Service
text: Software as a Service covers subscriptions for approved software capabilities and support. System as a Service is a proposed delivery model combining equipment access, maintenance, calibration and service. Commercial terms and prices remain to be validated.

topics.title: A traceable digital record for each plate
text: Connect sample identity, capture time, calibration, measurement, uncertainty, quality checks and review history. Clearly label every value as measured, derived, imputed or simulated. Missing information stays unavailable.

topics.title: Versioned rules and qualified review
text: Any future interpretation engine needs the applicable organism, antimicrobial, method and standards edition. Missing or unsupported combinations must not produce a clinical category. The current demonstration uses illustrative rules only.

topics.title: LIMS, LIS and hospital connectivity
text: Laboratory and hospital integration is a proposed workstream. Define identity mapping, permissions, message validation, downtime behavior and partner acceptance before connecting a real system.

topics.title: Human review and correction history
text: The synthetic review demonstration supports inspecting a measurement, making a correction and recording a review decision. Changing a measurement invalidates an earlier approval. Unreadable images require recapture.

topics.title: Local processing and offline reading
text: An offline reading edition can keep public explanations available without a connection. Local instrument operation is a separate engineering capability requiring validated controls and recovery behavior.

topics.title: Clinical microbiology workflow research
text: A potential application is digitizing approved plate measurements and their review history in clinical microbiology. Define the intended use, reference method and supervised evaluation before a clinical pilot.

topics.title: Direct MIC research pathway
text: Direct minimum inhibitory concentration measurement requires a qualified method such as broth microdilution. A zone diameter or a model prediction must not be represented as a directly measured MIC.

topics.title: Teaching and academic laboratories
text: Use synthetic demonstrations to teach measurement, uncertainty, review and evidence boundaries. A campus collaboration could begin with workflow discovery, training needs and a defined project brief.

topics.title: Heteroresistance and satellite-colony research
text: Small colonies or unusual growth patterns can motivate research questions. They do not establish a resistance mechanism, clinical interpretation or strain identity without a qualified assay and independent confirmation.

topics.title: Biofilm, phenomics and colony morphology
text: Explore carefully defined image features and longitudinal observations. Separate observations from hypotheses and require assay-specific comparators. A plate image cannot by itself establish genotype or a complete biological state.

topics.title: One Health applications
text: Human, animal, food, water and environmental work have different specimens, methods and reporting requirements. Each proposed expansion needs its own intended-use definition and validation.

topics.title: Governed AMR surveillance
text: A future network could connect quality-controlled, authorized and de-identified laboratory records. The map on this website contains fixed synthetic counts and is not live surveillance.

topics.title: Custom laboratory automation
text: Start with an audit of workflow bottlenecks and existing instruments. Define a small automation project, its operator controls, safety responsibilities and measurable acceptance criteria.

topics.title: A staged product family
text: Begin with Reader V1 and evaluate broader portable, connected and research configurations as evidence and resources grow. Product illustrations are concepts. The technical implementation and cost assumptions belong in the protected review area.

topics.title: Validation before deployment
text: The first work packages are calibration, repeatability, reproducibility, readable-versus-unreadable decisions, uncertainty and qualified reference comparison. Sample counts, results and achieved performance must come from completed studies.

topics.title: Development and regulatory boundaries
text: The project does not claim clinical validation or regulatory clearance. A future intended use, evaluation plan and deployment pathway must be reviewed against the requirements that apply to the actual product and location.

topics.title: Comparing synthetic measurements
text: Compare the demonstration measurement with its labelled synthetic reference. Keep corrections, reviewer decisions and disagreement visible. This illustrates traceability and does not measure clinical accuracy.

topics.title: Unreadable images and recapture
text: When an image cannot support a measurement, the result should remain unavailable. The demonstration includes an unreadable scenario and does not manufacture a number or an approval for it.

topics.title: Public offline reading
text: The offline reading edition includes public explanations only. Protected technical content requires a connection and an authorized admin session.

topics.title: Goa diagnostic-access research
text: Study diagnostic access and public spending with dated, attributable sources. Observed statistics, owner assumptions and scenario outputs must remain distinct; a modelled saving is not an achieved outcome.

topics.title: Preparedness scenarios
text: Explore how better records might support future preparedness, using transparent assumptions and sensitivity ranges. Do not present simulated time, cost or health outcomes as observed benefits.

topics.title: Model evaluation and data rights
text: Evaluate models against defined tasks, suitable reference data and failure cases. Record data permissions, version, provenance, uncertainty and limits. Computational predictions remain predictions.

topics.title: Reader V1: endpoint disk-diffusion reading
text: The present priority is an endpoint reader: a calibrated plate image, visible zone measurement, quality checks, uncertainty and qualified review. Broader instrument and assay capabilities remain separate proposals.

topics.title: Campus and laboratory audit collaboration
text: A proposed collaboration starts with equipment and workflow mapping, operator interviews, bottlenecks, training, data permissions and a scoped pilot. Agree the owner, deliverables, budget and acceptance criteria before work begins. No campus partnership is claimed as signed.

topics.title: Cell-culture workflow research
text: Explore record keeping, imaging review and workflow traceability for cell culture as a separate research direction. Requirements for cell lines, containment, imaging, quality controls and qualified supervision need independent definition. No automated culture capability is claimed.

topics.title: Stem-cell research workflows
text: Stem-cell work is a future research direction, not a current product capability or therapeutic service. Any collaboration needs an intended research question, appropriate approvals, qualified facilities and independent methods for identity and quality assessment.

topics.title: Organoid and tissue-model research
text: Organoids and tissue models are potential future research contexts. Define the biological model, authorized data, relevant measurements and independent validation before selecting hardware or making performance claims.

topics.title: UTI and urine-culture workflow research
text: A possible application is a bounded urine-culture laboratory workflow with validated plate reading and reviewable AST. It does not imply diagnosis directly from an unprocessed specimen or autonomous treatment advice.

topics.title: MRSA and molecular-result integration
text: Study how authorized results from qualified molecular instruments could complement phenotype records. Real-time PCR and reverse-transcription PCR are different methods; the intended method remains to be specified. No resistance gene is inferred from a plate image.

topics.title: Bioinformatics and phenotype–genotype research
text: Use traceable identifiers and versioned reference resources to study authorized phenotype and molecular data. Keep measured genotypes distinct from image-based hypotheses and computational predictions.

topics.title: Measured, derived, imputed and simulated data
text: Every plate value needs an origin label, unit, timestamp, uncertainty and quality state where applicable. A blank channel stays unavailable. Derived or imputed information must not silently become a direct measurement.

topics.title: Interoperability, APIs and audit trails
text: An interface needs a defined data contract, identity mapping, authorization, version handling and acceptance tests. Standards names and API availability do not mean a working hospital integration exists.

topics.title: System as a Service delivery model
text: Explore equipment access with maintenance, calibration, training and support as a service package. Keep it distinct from the software subscription, and validate customer demand, operating costs and contract terms before offering it commercially.

topics.title: Privacy and access governance
text: Keep public explanations separate from protected technical and partner material. Any real laboratory data would need appropriate rights, permissions, retention rules and a documented governance model before use.

topics.title: Automation vocabulary with practical meaning
text: Digital twin means a traceable record with clearly labelled data origins. Edge AI means processing close to the instrument. Human-in-the-loop means qualified review. Robotics, sensor fusion, multimodal AI, organoids and lab orchestration are research directions unless supported by specific completed evidence.
